title: Austin Debates Land, Water, Transit, Budget
summary:
*   Explored future city expansion by discussing the potential annexation of land near MoPac, Highway 71, and Boston Lane.
*   Addressed critical infrastructure and environmental concerns with reports on the Southwest Water Distribution System and a comprehensive Watershed Ordinance.
*   Worked on establishing new city policy for public right-of-way dedication and reservation, impacting urban development.
*   Reviewed progress on the Capital Metro transit system and set priorities for the upcoming city budget.
